verdicts.note: Use another letter for the source index on gaussian-resampling (the DFT page's j is an output index, the transform's frequency), or say on this page that j here is a position in the source vector u, not the DFT output index.
Use another letter for the Neumann summation index on gaussian-resampling, since r on the DFT page is the shifted index (l-k) mod q running over 0 to q-1.
Use another letter for the precision parameter on gaussian-resampling, since p on the radix-digit convolution page is the first integer being multiplied.
